// Embedded knowledge base from executive-summary.md and CLAUDE.md
const KNOWLEDGE_BASE = `
## About Nomos AI
Nomos AI is a Multi-RAG Orchestrator — an AI system that answers complex questions by searching multiple databases simultaneously. It uses 4 different search methods (pipelines) and an orchestrator that chooses the best method for each question.

## Project Goal
Build a response engine capable of handling 1 million+ questions across 4 business sectors (Construction, Industry, Finance, Legal) with 85%+ accuracy and <2.5s response time.

## Current Status (Phase 2)
- Phase 1 (200 questions): PASSED with 83.9% overall accuracy (Feb 20, 2026)
- Phase 2 (1,000 questions per pipeline): IN PROGRESS
  - Graph: COMPLETE (500/500, 78%)
  - Quantitative: COMPLETE (500/500, 92%)
  - Standard: PARTIAL (579/1000, ~36%)
  - Orchestrator: BROKEN (57/1000, 0%)
- Critical issue RESOLVED (Session 51): Root cause found — broken n8n expression syntax {{.VAR}} instead of {{$env.VAR}} in workflow JSONs. Fixed 17 instances, v5.4 deploying.

## Architecture
The system runs across multiple machines:
- VM Google Cloud (34.136.180.66): Control tower, permanent, 970MB RAM, piloting only
- HF Space (16GB RAM): n8n execution layer, running 9 RAG + 3 PME workflows
- GitHub Codespaces (8GB RAM, ephemeral): Heavy testing, data ingestion
- Vercel: 4 live production websites

## The 4 RAG Pipelines

### 1. Standard Pipeline (textual search)
- Database: Pinecone (10,411 vectors, 1024-dim)
- Process: HyDE → Pinecone search → Jina reranking → LLM response
- Accuracy: Phase 1: 85.5%, Phase 2: ~36% (degradation under investigation)
- Webhook: /webhook/rag-multi-index-v3

### 2. Graph Pipeline (entities and relationships)
- Database: Neo4j (19,788 entities, 76,717 relations)
- Process: Entity extraction → Neo4j search → Subgraph retrieval → LLM synthesis
- Accuracy: Phase 1: 78.0%, Phase 2: 78.0% (500/500 COMPLETE)
- Webhook: /webhook/ff622742-6d71-4e91-af71-b5c666088717

### 3. Quantitative Pipeline (numbers and tables)
- Database: Supabase (40 tables, ~17,600 rows)
- Process: Financial intent → SQL generation → SQL execution → LLM interpretation
- Accuracy: Phase 1: 92.0%, Phase 2: 92.0% (500/500 COMPLETE)
- Webhook: /webhook/3e0f8010-39e0-4bca-9d19-35e5094391a9

### 4. Orchestrator Pipeline (combines all 3)
- Database: All (Pinecone + Neo4j + Supabase)
- Process: Intent classification → Task planning → Sub-pipeline execution → Result aggregation
- Accuracy: Phase 1: 80.0%, Phase 2: 0% (BROKEN)
- Webhook: /webhook/92217bb8-ffc8-459a-8331-3f553812c3d0

## Databases
- Pinecone: 22,070 vectors across 3 indexes (sota-rag-jina-1024, sota-rag-phase2-graph, sota-rag-cohere-1024)
- Neo4j Aura: 19,788 nodes, 76,717 relationships (people, organizations, cities, generic entities)
- Supabase: 40 tables, ~17,600 rows (financials, sales_data, employees, benchmark datasets)

## GitHub Repositories (7 total, all private)
1. mon-ipad: Control tower (directives, eval scripts, MCP configs, CLAUDE.md master)
2. rag-tests: Tests for 4 pipelines (Python eval scripts, results JSON)
3. rag-website: ETI showcase site (Next.js 14, 4 sectors, chatbots) — Live at nomos-ai-pied.vercel.app
4. rag-dashboard: Metrics dashboard (static HTML/JS) — Live at nomos-dashboard-alexis-morets-projects.vercel.app
5. rag-data-ingestion: Data ingestion (download scripts, ingestion workflows)
6. rag-pme-connectors: PME connectors site (15 app integrations) — Live at nomos-pme-connectors-alexis-morets-projects.vercel.app
7. rag-pme-usecases: PME use cases site (200 use cases catalog) — Live at nomos-pme-usecases-alexis-morets-projects.vercel.app

## Technology Stack
- Workflow Engine: n8n 2.8.4 (on HF Space)
- LLMs: Llama 70B, Gemma 27B (via OpenRouter, 7 keys configured for rotation)
- Embeddings: Jina AI (embeddings-v3, 2 keys, 1M tokens/month each)
- Vector DB: Pinecone (Free tier, 100K vectors)
- Graph DB: Neo4j Aura (Free tier, 200K nodes)
- SQL DB: Supabase (Free tier, 500MB)
- Reranking: Jina (primary), Cohere (backup, trial almost exhausted)
- Control: Claude Code (Opus 4.6) on VM via Termius

## Key Metrics
- Questions tested to date: 1,520+ (Phase 1 + Phase 2)
- Phase 1 accuracy (baseline): 83.9% PASSED
- Phase 2 accuracy (partial): Graph 78%, Quant 92%, Std ~36%, Orch 0%
- Commits since start: 200+
- Sessions: 51
- Live websites: 4

## Recent Progress (Sessions 42-51)
- Session 42: VM n8n REMOVED (freed ~270MB RAM). VM is piloting-only now.
- Session 43: HF Space rebuilt with queue mode (3 workers), Supabase PostgreSQL, 7 OpenRouter keys.
- Sessions 44-50: Multiple entrypoint.sh fix attempts, credential management, activation debugging.
- Session 51: ROOT CAUSE FOUND — broken env var syntax {{.VAR}} instead of {{$env.VAR}} in workflow JSONs. Fixed 17 instances, deploying v5.4.

## Next Priorities
1. VERIFY HF SPACE v5.4: Test all 4 pipelines confirm valid responses
2. RELAUNCH STANDARD: Complete remaining 421/1000 questions
3. FIX ORCHESTRATOR: Debug intent classifier + routing (0% accuracy)
4. ACTIVATE PME WORKFLOWS: Configure Google API credentials
5. Complete data-ingestion: musique + finqa downloads

## Technical Details
- VM: Google Cloud e2-micro (1 vCPU, 970MB RAM, 30GB disk, Debian 11)
- HF Space URL: https://lbjlincoln-nomos-rag-engine.hf.space
- n8n Configuration: SQLite + Redis, queue mode (1 main + 2 workers)
- MCP Servers: 7 configured (n8n, pinecone, neo4j, supabase, jina-embeddings, cohere, huggingface)
- All credentials stored in .env.local (NEVER in git)

## Calling the Pipelines
All 4 pipelines use identical POST format:
curl -X POST "https://lbjlincoln-nomos-rag-engine.hf.space/webhook/<path>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query": "Your question here", "sessionId": "optional"}'

IMPORTANT: The field is "query" (NOT "question").

## Multi-Model Strategy
- Opus 4.6: Brain — analysis, decisions, piloting (primary model)
- Sonnet 4.5: Arms — web research, batch commands (delegated when relevant)
- Haiku 4.5: Sprint — fast codebase exploration (delegated for simple searches)
- Opus decides WHEN to delegate. Never the reverse.
`;

const query = $input.item.json.query.toLowerCase();

// Split knowledge into paragraphs
const paragraphs = KNOWLEDGE_BASE.split('\n\n').filter(p => p.trim());

// Simple keyword scoring
const queryWords = query
  .split(/\s+/)
  .filter(w => w.length > 3)
  .map(w => w.replace(/[^\w]/g, ''));

const scoredParagraphs = paragraphs.map(para => {
  const paraLower = para.toLowerCase();
  let score = 0;
  
  queryWords.forEach(word => {
    const regex = new RegExp(word, 'gi');
    const matches = paraLower.match(regex);
    if (matches) {
      score += matches.length;
    }
  });
  
  return { text: para, score };
});

// Get top 5 most relevant paragraphs
const topParagraphs = scoredParagraphs
  .filter(p => p.score > 0)
  .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
  .slice(0, 5)
  .map(p => p.text);

const context = topParagraphs.length > 0 
  ? topParagraphs.join('\n\n')
  : KNOWLEDGE_BASE.substring(0, 2000); // Fallback to first 2000 chars

return {
  query: $input.item.json.query,
  sessionId: $input.item.json.sessionId,
  context: context,
  paragraphsFound: topParagraphs.length
};
